item.title: Han Dong-hoon: “An order to run? That’s presidential election interference.” Ha Jung-woo: “I persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader.’” (한동훈 “출마 지시? 대통령 선거개입”, 하정우 “내가 통님 설득”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI future strategy at the Blue House, and Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party, are clashing on social media, as both are likely to face off in the by-election for the Buk-gu Gap constituency in Busan. (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 맞붙을 가능성이 큰 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(인공지능·AI) 미래기획수석비서관과 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표가 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서 맞붙고 있다.)

On Facebook on the 28th, former leader Han said, “Former senior secretary Ha said, ‘If President Lee Jae-myung tells me to run in Buk-gu Gap, I will run; otherwise, I’ll stay at the Blue House.’ Since he is running, it appears President Lee ultimately gave the order to run. I ask former secretary Ha and the Blue House: Did President Lee order him to run in Buk-gu Gap? If so, that is illegal election interference by the president.” (한 전 대표는 28일 페이스북에서 “하 전 수석은 ‘이재명 대통령이 부산 북갑에 출마하라고 해야 출마할 거고, 아니면 청와대에 남겠다’고 말했는데, 출마하는 것을 보니 이 대통령이 결국 출마 지시를 한 것으로 보인다”며 “하 전 수석과 청와대에 묻는다. 이 대통령이 하 전 수석에게 부산 북갑 출마 지시한 것 맞냐? 그렇다면, 이 대통령의 불법 선거개입이다”라고 말했다.)

After a netizen shared a news article about this on X (formerly Twitter) that same day, protesting to former secretary Ha, “Why are you dragging the president into this?”, Ha directly replied. (이 내용이 기사화된 것을 한 누리꾼이 이날 엑스(X)에 공유하며 하 전 수석을 향해 “왜 대통령님을 끌어들이냐?”고 항의하자, 하 전 수석은 직접 답글을 달았다.)

Former secretary Ha said, “I persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader’ (a nickname for Lee Jae-myung), and he readily agreed after hearing my opinion. He told me to work hard for the national interest wherever I go. It wasn’t an order from the Supreme Leader—I persuaded him, so it cannot be election interference. We don’t need to be swayed by such forced logic.” (하 전 수석은 “제가 통님을 설득했고 제 의견에 동의해서 바로 흔쾌히 수락했다. 그래서 어디서든 국익을 위해 힘쓰라 했다. 통님 지시가 아니고 제가 설득한 거니 선거 개입이 될 수 없다. 억지 논리에 일희일비할 필요 없다”고 말했다.)

In response, former leader Han shared Ha’s reply and said, “When I pointed out that if President Lee had ordered him to run, it would be illegal election interference, former secretary Ha changed his story, saying he himself persuaded the ‘Supreme Leader’ (President Lee Jae-myung, right?) to run, so it isn’t election interference. It’s a problem if former secretary Ha wanted to run but lied by using President Lee as an excuse, and it’s also a problem if President Lee did give an illegal order to run and they are lying as if it didn’t happen.” (이에 한 전 대표는 하 전 수석의 답글을 공유하며 “제가 이 대통령이 출마하라고 지시했다면 불법 선거개입이라고 지적하자, 하 전 수석 본인이 출마하겠다고 ‘통님(이재명 대통령 맞지요?)’을 설득했으니 선거개입이 아니라고 말을 바꿨다”라며 “하 전 수석 본인이 출마하고 싶은데도 이 대통령 핑계 대며 거짓말을 했어도 문제이고, 이 대통령이 불법 출마지시를 했음에도 아닌 것처럼 거짓말하는 것이어도 문제”라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, former secretary Ha is set to begin his full-fledged campaign on the 29th, completing his party admission process at the Democratic Party headquarters in the morning and visiting Gupo Market in the Buk-gu Gap district in the afternoon. Accordingly, the Buk-gu Gap by-election, held alongside the June 3 local elections, is likely to be a three-way race between former secretary Ha of the Democratic Party, former leader Han, and a candidate from the People Power Party. Within the People Power Party, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik and others are hoping to run. (한편, 하 전 수석은 29일 오전 더불어민주당 중앙당에서 입당 절차를 마친 뒤 오후 부산 북갑 지역구의 구포시장을 방문하는 등 본격적인 출마 행보에 나설 예정이다. 이에 따라 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 보궐선거는 더불어민주당 하 전 수석과 한 전 대표, 그리고 국민의힘 후보가 겨루게 될 가능성이 커졌다. 국민의힘에선 박민식 전 국가보훈처 장관 등이 출마를 희망 중이다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam "I'm in first place" – Cho Kuk "I will win"…'Pyeongtaek-eul Battle' heats up into a war of nerves (김용남 “내가 1등” 조국 “내가 이겨”…‘평택을 전투’ 기싸움 본격화)
item.description:
The campaign for the June 3 parliamentary by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul is seeing a growing war of words between Kim Yong-nam, a former Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker, and Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. (6·3 국회의원 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마한 김용남 전 더불어민주당 의원과 조국 조국혁신당 대표의 장외 기싸움이 이어지고 있다.)

On the 29th, candidate Kim shared on Facebook the results of a poll by 'Korea Research Flower,' which showed he had the highest approval rating among Pyeongtaek-eul candidates, saying, "The support the citizens of Pyeongtaek are showing me now is not so much an encouragement of me personally, but a fervent hope for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, and a solemn yet heartfelt command to bring about the development of Pyeongtaek." He added, "I will not be intoxicated by the poll rankings. I will focus only on the essence of elections: the lives of the citizens." (김 후보는 29일 페이스북에 자신이 평택을 후보 중 지지율이 가장 높게 나타난 ‘여론조사 꽃’의 조사 결과를 공유하며 “지금 평택시민들이 보여주시는 지지는 저 개인에 대한 응원보다는, 이재명 정부의 성공을 향한 간절한 염원이자, 평택의 발전을 가져오라는 준엄하면서도 진심 어린 명령”이라고 말했다. 그는 “여론조사 순위에 도취하지 않겠다. 오직 선거의 본질인 ‘시민의 삶’에만 집중하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Candidate Cho appeared on the YouTube broadcast 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory' that day, which released this poll, and said, "People I meet in Pyeongtaek all say that until now, Pyeongtaek has never received national attention, so they're glad it's becoming a political hotspot, and that they hope someone who can resolve Pyeongtaek's long-standing issues will come." (조 후보는 이날 이 여론조사를 발표한 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’ 유튜브 방송에 출연해 “평택에서 만나는 분들이 지금까지 평택이 전국적 조명을 받은 적이 없는데 정치1번지가 되어서 좋다, 평택의 숙원사업을 해결해줄 사람이 오면 좋겠다는 이야기를 꼭 하신다”고 말했다.)

Regarding a potential unification with the Democratic Party, Candidate Cho stated, "Because I ran based on the premise of receiving the Democratic Party's nomination, I must naturally compete with and defeat the Democratic Party candidate," adding, "I have a duty to prove that Cho Kuk is better for the development of South Korea and Pyeongtaek than candidate Kim Yong-nam." He then said, "I am always open. It's too hasty to discuss it now; talks will likely happen around May 20th, when the election campaign officially begins." (조 후보는 민주당과의 단일화와 관련해 “민주당 공천을 전제로 출마했기 때문에 당연히 민주당 후보와 경쟁해서 이겨야 한다”며 “조국이 김용남 후보보다 대한민국과 평택 발전을 위해 더 낫다는 걸 입증할 의무를 갖는 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “항상 열려 있다. 지금 이야기를 하는 건 성급하고, 5월20일 선거운동 개시일 그때쯤 얘기가 나올 것”이라고 했다.)

Responding aggressively to candidate Kim's past 'shots' regarding the controversy over private equity funds involving Cho himself and his family during his time as Minister of Justice, Candidate Cho said, "I want to be clear about this regarding my honor. The private equity fund issue was not even investigated, and while my fifth cousin and spouse were partially convicted, the judgment explicitly states there was no corrupt abuse of power related to me." He added, "If candidate Kim brings up these falsehoods again, I will counterattack to protect my own honor." He also directly demanded of candidate Kim, "Explain to the public three public statements you made: defending the 'Korea-Japan Comfort Women Agreement' during the Park Geun-hye administration, calling the activities of the Sewol Ferry Special Investigation Committee a 'waste of tax money,' and claiming the cause of the Itaewon disaster was the 'Gwanghwamun rally and Yongsan march the day before.'" (조 후보는 법무부 장관 시절 김 후보가 자신과 가족들의 사모펀드 논란 등을 ‘저격’한 것에 대해 “제 명예와 관련해 꼭 짚고 싶다. 사모펀드는 수사 자체를 받지 않았고, 5촌 조카와 배우자가 일부 유죄를 받았으나 판결문에는 저와 관련한 권력형 비리가 아니라고 딱 적혀있다”고 적극 반박했다. 그러면서 “김 후보가 허위사실을 지금 다시 꺼낸다면 제 자신의 명예를 지키기 위해서라도 반격하겠다”고 했다. 또 김 후보에게 “박근혜 정부 시절 ‘한일 위안부 합의’ 옹호, 세월호 특조위 활동을 ‘세금 낭비’라고 한 것, 이태원 참사 원인을 ‘전날 광화문집회 용산 행진’이라고 한 것 등 세가지 공개 발언에 대해 국민들에게 해명하라”고 직접 요구했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon's First Pledge: 'Steel-Strength Seoul' – "Creating a 10-Minute Fitness Zone" (오세훈, 1호 공약 ‘강철 체력 서울’…“10분 운세권 만들 것”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, unveiled a 'Healthy City' as his first pledge on the 29th. The plan involves advancing Seoul's existing health management platform and expanding sports-for-life infrastructure, such as the Seoul Physical Fitness Test. (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 29일 1호 공약으로 ‘건강 도시’를 내걸었다. 기존 서울시 건강관리 플랫폼을 고도화하고 서울체력장 등 생활체육 인프라를 확충하겠다는 구상이다.)

On the morning of the same day, at the 'Seoul Fitness 9988 Dobong Center' located in the Dobong-gu Public Health Center, the candidate announced 'Steel-Strength, Vital Seoul' as his first pledge. Regarding the choice of health policies as his first pledge, he explained, "I constantly ask myself what citizens value most in their daily lives," and said, "It's not money, a house, or a job—it's health." He continued, "Our society has so far treated health solely as a personal matter," adding, "But health must be a public infrastructure that the city collaboratively designs and supports." The intent is to prevent disparities in income and assets from leading to health disparities. <<>> Oh announced that he would upgrade Seoul's health management platform 'Wrist Doctor 9988,' launched in 2021, into an AI-based health management super app. The advanced app plans to integrate personal health checkup results and exercise data to predict risks of chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension, as well as severe conditions like lung cancer. Oh stated, "By signing an MOU with the National Health Insurance Service, we will combine health-related disease histories with exercise data accumulated in the app," and "Based on exercise habits and disease/treatment histories, AI-customized prescriptions will become possible." Plans also include allowing the purchase of digital health devices, such as blood glucose monitors, using Wrist Doctor 9988 points, and providing sports facility vouchers to citizens diagnosed with obesity to encourage exercise. <<>> The sports-for-life infrastructure will also be significantly expanded. Oh announced the creation of a '10-minute fitness zone' city, where citizens can manage their physical fitness within 10 minutes of their home anywhere in Seoul. First, the number of 'Seoul Physical Fitness Centers' in residential areas, currently at 27, will be increased to 100. These centers are spaces where citizens can measure their fitness levels and receive exercise prescriptions. 'Fun Stations' centered on running and fitness, utilizing subway stations like Yeouinaru, Ttukseom, and Gwanghwamun, will also be expanded from the current 6 to 25. Additionally, 120 new 'Our Neighborhood Vitality Charging Stations' for the elderly will be established by 2030, and indoor and outdoor park golf courses and senior exercise playgrounds will be expanded. <<>> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr ( 오 후보는 이날 오전 서울 도봉구보건소에 있는 ‘서울체력 9988 도봉센터’에서 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울'을 첫 공약으로 발표했다. 그는 1호 공약으로 건강 정책을 선택한 이유에 대해 “시민들이 일상에서 가장 소중하게 여기는 것은 무엇일까를 늘 스스로 묻는다”며 “돈도, 집도, 직업도 아닌 건강”이라고 밝혔다. 이어 “우리 사회는 그동안 건강을 오롯이 개인의 문제로만 여겨왔다”며 “하지만 건강은 도시가 함께 설계하고 뒷받침해야 할 공공의 인프라여야 한다”고 했다. 소득·자산 격차가 건강 격차로 이어지는 것을 막겠다는 취지다.)

item.title: “Bae Hyun-jin, a cancerous presence”…Public remarks by People Power Party Supreme Council member appointed by Jang Dong-hyuk (“배현진, 암적 존재”…장동혁이 지명한 국힘 최고위원 공개발언)
item.description:
Cho Kwang-han, a Supreme Council member of the People Power Party appointed as a designated Supreme Council member by party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, criticized fellow party lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin, calling her "a cancerous presence in our party." <<> On the 28th, a broadcast on the channel of far-right YouTuber Koh Sung-kook showed Koh first launching into a critique of Rep. Bae during a conversation with Supreme Council member Cho. Koh said, "Looking at what Bae Hyun-jin is doing, it’s not just crossing the line—it’s deeply malicious and truly repetitive. She even belittled and harshly condemned Chairman Jang’s visit to the U.S., saying things like, ‘It seems he was deceived by some shady broker.’ Are you just going to let this slide?" <<> Earlier, Rep. Bae had consistently criticized Chairman Jang, making remarks such as, "You live such a difficult life, Jang Dong-hyuk" (March 12), "(Chairman Jang’s) campaign visits don’t help a single electoral district" (March 25), and "The worst anti-party act is all of Chairman Jang’s choices that hinder candidates and tank the party’s competitiveness" (April 23). On the 27th, on SBS Radio’s "Kim Tae-hyun’s Political Show," she said regarding Jang’s U.S. trip performance, "It seems like he was tricked by so-called brokers or lobbyists in the U.S., these shady people, and went there deceived." <<> In response to Koh’s remarks, Supreme Council member Cho said, "As Dr. Koh said, this (Rep. Bae’s criticism of Chairman Jang) is happening continuously and repeatedly. A lot of people are boiling with anger. If we were to mention that boiling anger, very unpleasant language would come out—because it becomes an attack on the other side." He added, "So, in fact, we have to see her as a cancerous presence in our party." <<> Supreme Council member Cho continued, "The Seoul party chapter has almost completely collapsed and been ruined," and "Many of our Seoul city party committee chairs have been hurt and are in a situation where they have no choice but to suppress their anger." This was another critique aimed at Rep. Bae, who serves as the chair of the People Power Party’s Seoul city chapter. He also appeared to target the court’s decision last month to grant Rep. Bae’s request for a temporary injunction, which halted the party’s ethics committee’s February punishment of a one-year suspension of her party membership, saying, "We also find it very troubling that the court has excessively intervened in the political activities of a political party." <<> Meanwhile, Rep. Bae was referred to the People Power Party’s ethics committee again on the 24th, following a previous referral in January. Some candidates for Seoul metropolitan and district council seats in the People Power Party cited the reason for the referral, stating, "The respondent (Rep. Bae), who is the Seoul city party committee chair, has not stopped criticizing and mocking the party leadership, including Chairman Jang, during this critical time ahead of the local elections." This referral came just one day after Chairman Jang returned from the U.S. and warned, "I will take strong action against anti-party behavior." <<> Regarding the ethics committee referral, Rep. Bae said on a radio show on the 27th, "It’s not something I need to worry about much," and "Since the court has already blocked them once before, the ethics committee won’t act rashly or recklessly." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 지명직 최고위원으로 임명한 조광한 국민의힘 최고위원이 배현진 국민의힘 의원을 겨냥해 “우리 당의 암적 존재”라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Presidential Office Introduces ‘Grade 5 Promotion Fast Track’ for Civil Servants… Expands Open Positions (청와대, 공무원 ‘5급 승진 패스트트랙’ 도입…개방형 직위도 확대)
item.description:
On the 29th, the Presidential Office announced the ‘Public Service Competency Enhancement Plan,’ which includes the introduction of a ‘Grade 5 Promotion Fast Track’ for civil servants. (청와대가 29일 공무원 ‘5급 승진 패스트트랙’ 도입하는 내용 등을 담은 ‘공직 역량 강화 방안’을 발표했다.)

Chief of Staff to the President Kang Hoon-sik stated at a briefing at the Presidential Office, “By introducing the Grade 5 special promotion fast track, we will enable capable individuals to quickly grow into managerial roles,” adding, “This involves accelerated promotion after thorough verification, starting with 100 people this year and gradually expanding.” (강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “5급 특진 패스트트랙을 도입해 역량 있는 사람은 빠르게 관리자로 성장시키겠다”며 “철저한 검증을 거쳐 조기 승진시키는 것으로, 올해 100명을 시작으로 단계적으로 확대할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Furthermore, the office announced plans to cultivate expert civil servants in fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), trade, and labor supervision. Chief Kang said, “In areas like AI, trade, and labor supervision, we will allow long-term service of over seven years to build expertise and provide regular training,” and “In particular, AI-related civil servants will work across ministry boundaries, such as the Ministry of Science and ICT and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.” Currently, under the rotational assignment system, positions change every one to two years. Chief Kang added, “This is about creating a public service culture centered on performance and results.” (아울러 인공지능(AI) 통상, 노동감독 등 전문가 공무원을 양성하겠다고 밝혔다. 강 실장은 “에이아이, 통상, 노동감독 등의 분야는 7년 이상 장기 재직해서 실력을 쌓을 수 있게 하고 주기적으로 교육하겠다”며 “특히 인공지능 관련 공무원은 과학기술정보통신부, 행정안전부 등 부처 칸막이 없이 일하도록 하겠다”고 말했다. 현재는 순환보직 제도에 따라 1~2년이 지나면 보직을 바꾸게 된다. 강 실장은 “실적과 성과 중심의 공직문화를 만들겠다는 것”이라고 했다.)

As a measure to attract private-sector talent, the office also decided to gradually expand ‘open positions.’ As of January last year, open positions at the bureau and division head level accounted for 7.1%, with a plan to increase this to 12% by 2030. According to the plan, salary caps will be abolished for certain positions, and employment restrictions will be eased. Additionally, the office announced plans to systematize lifelong education for civil servants and establish a national-level overseas human network management system. (민간 인재를 유인하는 방안으로 ‘개방형 직위’도 단계적으로 확대해 나가기로 했다. 지난해 1월 기준 국·과장급 개방형 직위는 7.1%인데, 오는 2030년까지 12%로 늘리겠다는 것이다. 직위에 따라 연봉 상한을 폐지하고 취업제한을 완화한다는 계획이다. 이 밖에도 공무원 생애주기별 교육을 체계화하고 국가 차원의 해외 인적네트워크 관리체계도 구축하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kang stated, “We will immediately amend relevant laws to implement this swiftly,” adding, “I believe this will serve as a foundation for a dramatic leap in public service competency amid a rapidly changing environment.” (강 실장은 “즉시 관계 법령을 개정해 신속하게 시행하겠다”며 “급변하는 환경 속에서 공직 역량을 획기적으로 도약시키는 밑바탕이 되리라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Photo] Jung Won-oh on 'Real Estate' vs. Oh Se-hoon on 'Health'… Seoul mayoral candidates' pledge competition heats up ([포토] 정원오 ‘부동산’ 대 오세훈 ‘건강’…서울시장 후보 공약 경쟁 본격화)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, each announced their pledges for the June 3 local elections, kicking off their policy campaigns in earnest. Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh visited the Jangwi redevelopment district in Seongbuk-dong, Seoul on the 29th and unveiled a real estate policy focused on shortening redevelopment project timelines and supplying a large volume of 'substantial housing.' Candidate Jung stated, "We will supply a large number of public housing units at prices and rents that are affordable for non-homeowning middle-class citizens." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 각각 6·3 지방선거 공약을 발표하며 본격적인 정책 행보를 시작했다. 정원오 민주당 후보는 29일 서울 성북동 장위재개발지구를 현장방문해 정비사업 기간의 단축과 ‘실속주택’ 대규모 공급을 주요 내용으로 하는 부동산 정책을 발표했다. 정 후보는 “무주택 중산층 서민들도 부담 가능한 분양가와 임대료의 공공주택을 대규모로 공급하겠다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon announced 'Steel Stamina, Vibrant Seoul' as his first pledge. On the 29th, at the Dobong-gu Public Health Center in Seoul, Oh unveiled a public health pledge, declaring the creation of an urban environment where everyone can enjoy a healthy daily life regardless of where they live or their income level, as the top priority for completing quality of life. Candidate Oh emphasized, "Regardless of where you live or what you do, health should not be a goal but part of daily life itself in Seoul," adding, "Reducing health disparities by region and income is a key task for completing the 'Special City of Quality of Life' and enhancing urban competitiveness." Afterward, Oh visited Ssangmun Market in Dobong-gu, Seoul, and the area known as Ssangridangil to meet with citizens. (오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 1호 공약으로 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울’을 발표했다. 오 후보는 29일 서울 도봉구보건소에서 삶의 질을 완성하기 위한 최우선 과제로 거주 지역이나 소득 수준과 관계없이 누구나 건강한 일상을 누리는 도시 환경을 조성하겠다고 시민 건강공약을 밝혔다. 오 후보는 “어디에 살든, 어떤 일을 하든 건강은 목표가 아니라 서울에서의 일상 그 자체여야 한다”라며 “지역·소득별 건강 격차를 줄이는 것이야말로 ‘삶의 질 특별시’를 완성하고 도시 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 과제”라고 강조했다. 이후 오 후보는 서울 도봉구 쌍문시장과 일명 쌍리단길을 찾아 시민들을 만났다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders Review to Allow Use of High Oil Price Subsidies at Gas Stations with Annual Revenue Over 3 Billion Won (이 대통령 “매출 30억 이상 주유소서 고유가 지원금 가능하게” 검토 지시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung reportedly instructed on the 29th that the high oil price relief subsidies be made available for use at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more. (이재명 대통령이 고유가 피해지원금을 ‘연 매출 30억원 이상 주유소’에서도 사용할 수 있도록 검토해보라고 지시한 것으로 29일 알려졌다.)

Chief Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Gyu-yeon said on KBS Radio that day, "(Yesterday) President Lee asked senior secretaries for their opinions on the restriction of using high oil price relief subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue over 3 billion won. He said, 'Intuitively, citizens see it as a high oil price relief subsidy, so shouldn't they be allowed to at least fill up on gas?' and ordered a review in the direction of easing that restriction." (이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 “전날 (이 대통령이) 수석들에게(연 매출 30억 이상 주유소에서 고유가 피해지원금 사용 제한에 대한) 의견을 들어보자고 했다”며 “‘아무래도 국민들이 직관적으로 받아들이는 것은 고유가 피해 지원금이니까 기름 정도는 넣을 수 있게 해야 되는 거 아니냐’ 해서 그걸 한 번 풀어주는 방향으로 검토해 보라고 (이 대통령이) 지시를 내렸다”고 말했다.)

The government has been providing 'high oil price relief subsidies' since the 27th to alleviate the increased burden on citizens due to the prolonged US-Israel/Iran war. However, it was pointed out that the inability to use these subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more has caused inconvenience. (정부는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화 탓에 늘어난 국민들의 부담 완화를 위해 오는 27일부터 ‘고유가 피해지원금’을 지급하고 있다. 그런데 연매출 30억원 이상인 주유소에서는 이를 쓸 수 없어 불편하다는 지적이 제기된 바 있다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk, with no one to back him... Immersed in SNS election campaign 'hitting President Lee' (불러주는 이 없는 장동혁…SNS서 ‘이 대통령 때리기’ 선거전 몰입)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is continuing his 'anti-opposition struggle' via social media (SNS). Ahead of the June 3 local elections, as candidates form their own independent election committees in a pattern of 'leader bypassing', he is focusing on 'rear support'—announcing central party pledges and criticizing President Lee Jae-myung through SNS. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 에스엔에스(SNS)로 ‘대여 투쟁’을 이어가고 있다. 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 후보들이 독자적 선거대책위원회를 구성하는 등 ‘대표 패싱’이 지속되면서 중앙당 공약 발표, 에스엔에스를 통한 이재명 대통령 비판 등 ‘후방 지원’에 몰입하는 모양새다.)

On the morning of the 29th, Leader Jang announced 'four major pledges for regions and livelihoods' at the National Assembly. The pledges included resolving polarization in the housing market between the capital region and provinces, promoting domestic production through tax policies, and building a safety net for small and medium-sized enterprise succession. Floor Leader Song Eon-seok did not attend the announcement. In the afternoon, he held a 'youth daily-life-centered pledge meeting' at a café in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, listening to 11 pledges proposed by young people. At this meeting, Policy Committee Chair Jung Jeom-sik, who oversees party policy, was absent, prompting Lee Yong-ho, the district committee chair for Seodaemun-gu in Seoul, to ask mid-speech, "Isn't the Policy Committee Chair here?" (장 대표는 29일 오전 국회에서 ‘지역·민생 4대 공약’을 발표했다. △수도권-지방 주택시장 양극화 해소 △국내생산 촉진 세제 △중소기업 승계 안전망 구축 등의 내용이 담겼다. 발표 현장에 송언석 원내대표는 참석하지 않았다. 오후에는 서울 서대문구 한 카페에서 ‘청년 생활밀착형 공약 간담회’를 열고 청년들이 제시하는 11개 공약을 청취했다. 이 간담회에는 당 정책을 총괄하는 정점식 정책위의장이 참석하지 않아 이용호 서울 서대문갑 당협위원장이 발언 도중 “정책위의장님 안 오셨어요?”라고 묻기도 했다.)

Leader Jang has been pouring out remarks targeting President Lee and Democratic Party of Korea candidates via SNS platforms like Facebook and X (formerly Twitter). On this day, he wrote on Facebook, "A Japanese oil tanker carrying crude oil is heading toward Japan through the Hormuz Strait without paying transit fees. Where is diplomacy genius President Lee Jae-myung and what is he doing?" He followed up with a post directed at the president, saying, "During his time in the opposition, he constantly obstructed foreign policy at every turn, but now that he's president, he's completely changed his tune. Stop the anti-America, pro-China stance and look back at 'Yesterday's Lee' first." (장 대표는 페이스북과 X(엑스) 등 에스엔에스를 통해 이 대통령과 더불어민주당 후보를 겨냥한 발언을 쏟아내고 있다. 그는 이날 페이스북에 “원유를 실은 일본 유조선이 호르무즈 해협을 통행료 없이 통과해 일본을 향하고 있다”며 “외교 천재 이재명 대통령은 어디서 뭘 하시나?"라고 썼다. 뒤이어 이 대통령을 향해 “야당 시절 사사건건 외교정책을 발목 잡더니 대통령 됐다고 얼굴을 싹 바꿨다. 반미친중을 중단하고 ‘어제명’부터 돌아보라”는 게시물을  올렸다. )

The day before, he posted three consecutive messages on Facebook. They included content like, "We will hold the Democratic Party regime, which injected mold vaccine into our citizens' arms, fully accountable," and "If Jeong Won-o is left in charge of Seoul's real estate, the outcome is obvious." He also offered a kind remark to Chungbuk Governor candidate Kim Young-hwan, who had said, "We must stop shaking the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership," stating, "Though your nomination came the latest, I believe you will deliver the victory report the earliest." Kim had initially been excluded (cut off) from the party primaries but, after a legal struggle, underwent a re-election and was finally confirmed as a candidate. (전날에는 페이스북에 게시물 3건을 잇달아 올렸다. “우리 국민의 팔에 곰팡이 백신을 놓은 민주당 정권에 응당한 책임을 묻겠다”, “정원오에게 서울 부동산 맡기면 결과는 뻔하다” 등의 내용이다. “장동혁 지도부를 흔드는 일을 멈춰야 한다”고 말한 김영환 충북지사 후보를 향해 “공천은 가장 늦었지만 승전보는 가장 먼저 울려주실 것으로 믿는다”고 덕담을 건넸다. 김 후보는 애초 당 경선에서 공천배제(컷오프) 됐다가 법적 투쟁 끝에 재경선을 치러 후보로 최종 결정됐다.)

Earlier, Leader Jang visited Incheon on the 6th and Yangyang County in Gangwon on the 22nd, but after hearing blunt criticisms like "The public sentiment in the capital region is in an ice age" (Rep. Yoon Sang-hyun) and "We need to solve what we have caused" (Gangwon Governor Kim Jin-tae), he has not scheduled any further public regional events. Candidates for metropolitan mayoral positions in Busan, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, Gangwon, and Sejong have appointed former Employment and Labor Minister Kim Moon-soo as honorary election committee chair. Pro-Chun faction lawmaker Jeong Seong-guk (Busan Busanjin-gu) said in an interview on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show," "There is a judgment that Kim's joining, who has a broader supporter spectrum than Leader Jang, will be more helpful for the election." (앞서, 장 대표는 지난 6일에는 인천, 지난 22일에는 강원 양양군을 찾았다가 “수도권 민심은 빙하기 그 자체”(윤상현 의원), “결자해지가 필요하다”(김진태 강원지사) 등 ‘면전 쓴소리’를 들은 뒤 지역 공개 일정을 잡지 않고 있다. 부산·대구·경북·강원·세종 지역 광역단체장 후보들은 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 명예 선거대책위원장으로 내세웠다. 친한계 정성국 의원(부산 부산진갑)은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’ 인터뷰에서 “장 대표보다 지지층 스펙트럼이 넓은 김 전 장관의 합류가 선거에 더 도움이 된다는 판단이 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Myung-bak: "The public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end" — Meeting with Kim Eun-hye revealed (이명박 “국민, 끝까지 국힘 기대 저버리지 않을 것”…김은혜 면담 공개)
item.description:
With the People Power Party's approval rating dropping to 15% ahead of the June 3 local elections, former President Lee Myung-bak reportedly said, "The public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end," according to Rep. Kim Eun-hye, the party's senior deputy chief policymaker. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 지지율이 15%까지 떨어진 가운데 이명박 전 대통령이 “국민은 마지막까지 국민의힘에 기대를 저버리시지 않을 것”이라고 말했다고 국민의힘 원내정책수석부대표인 김은혜 의원이 전했다.)

Rep. Kim posted on Facebook on the 29th, "I went to meet with former President Lee Myung-bak." She conveyed that "former President Lee said, 'I am well aware that the party is in a difficult situation. Nevertheless, the public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end. Please look at reality with a cool head and run a campaign that can win the election.'" Rep. Kim revealed that she met with former President Lee for about an hour. (김 의원은 29일 페이스북에 “이명박 전 대통령을 만나 뵙고 왔다”는 글을 올렸다. 김 의원은 “(이 전 대통령이) ‘당이 어려운 상황임을 잘 알고 있다. 그럼에도 국민은 마지막까지 국민의힘에 기대를 저버리지 않을 것이다. 현실을 냉철하게 돌아보고 이기는 선거를 해달라’고 당부해줬다”고 전했다. 김 의원은 이 대통령과 한 시간 정도 만남을 가졌다고 밝혔다.)

Rep. Kim noted that a four-character idiom, "Hancheonjaku" (When the people fall into utter misery, heaven opens a path), was framed in former President Lee's office, saying, "We will recognize our shortcomings, heed only the will of the people, and approach the June 3 election with that mindset." Rep. Kim previously served as the presidential spokesperson during former President Lee's tenure. (김 의원은 “백성이 도탄에 빠지면 하늘이 길을 열어준다”는 뜻의 사자성어 ‘한천작우’가 이 전 대통령 사무실 액자 안에 담겨있었다면서 “저희의 부족함을 깨닫고, 국민의 뜻만 받들며 6·3 선거에 임하겠다”고 했다. 김 의원은 이 전 대통령 재임 당시 청와대 대변인을 지낸 바 있다.)

Indeed, the People Power Party is in a "difficult situation." According to a National Barometer Survey (NBS) released on the 23rd by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (a telephone survey with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), the People Power Party's approval rating was 15%, the lowest since it changed its name to "People Power Party." Even in Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, considered the "heart of conservatism," the Democratic Party (34%) surpassed the People Power Party (25%). The survey was conducted from the 20th to the 22nd among 1,005 people aged 18 or older. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (실제 국민의힘은 “어려운 상황”에 처해있다. 지난 23일 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 국민의힘 지지율은 15%로 ‘국민의힘’으로 이름을 바꾼 뒤 최저치를 기록했다. ‘보수의 심장’ 대구·경북에서도 민주당(34%)이 국민의힘(25%)을 앞서는 결과가 나왔다. 해당 조사는 지난 20∼22일 만 18살 이상 국민 1005명을 대상으로 진행됐다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의원회 누리집을 참고하면 된다.)

Earlier, former President Lee held his first interview since leaving office with the JoongAng Ilbo last month, delivering sharp criticism to conservative forces torn between "Yoon Again" and "Cutting ties with Yoon" (breaking off relations with former President Yoon). At the time, former President Lee stated, "A conservative party that suffered a crushing defeat should look to the future—does it make sense to be divided over former President Yoon, who is already in the past?" He added, "Leave the judgment on former President Yoon to the law, and the opposition party should present a vision that the public can accept and move forward toward the future." (앞서 이 전 대통령은 지난달 중앙일보와 퇴임 뒤 첫 인터뷰를 진행하며 ‘윤 어게인’과 ‘절윤’(윤 전 대통령과의 절연) 사이에서 갈등을 빚고 있는 보수 세력을 향해 쓴소리를 한 바 있다. 당시 이 전 대통령은 “참패한 보수가 미래를 보고 나가야지 이미 지나간 과거인 윤 전 대통령을 가지고 갈라져 있다는 게 말이 되나”라며 “윤 전 대통령에 대한 판단은 법에 맡기고, 야당은 국민이 납득할 수 있는 비전을 제시하고 미래를 향해 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Should We Call 'North Korea' 'Joseon'?… Vice Minister of Unification "A Name That Respects the Other Is Necessary" (‘북한’을 ‘조선’이라 부를까…통일부 차관 “상대 존중하는 호칭 필요”)
item.description:
A academic conference that brings the issue of referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (Joseon), into public debate was held under the sponsorship of the Ministry of Unification. (북한을 정식 국호인 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국(조선)’으로 호칭하는 문제를 공론화하는 학술회의가 통일부 후원으로 열렸다.)

The Korean Political Science Association held a special academic conference on the 29th at the Seoul Press Center under the theme "Naming for Peaceful Coexistence: North Korea or Joseon?" In a congratulatory speech, Vice Minister of Unification Kim Nam-joong said, "When language that acknowledges and respects the reality of the other side is institutionally supported, we can break the vicious cycle of confrontation and broaden the space for peaceful coexistence." (한국정치학회는 29일 서울 프레스센터에서 ‘평화 공존을 위한 이름 부르기: 북한인가 조선인가'를 주제로 특별학술회의를 열었다. 김남중 통일부 차관은 이날 축사에서 “상대의 실체를 인정하고 존중하는 언어가 제도적으로 뒷받침될 때 대결의 악순환을 끊고 평화 공존의 공간을 넓혀갈 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Professor Kim Seong-kyung of Sogang University stated that 'North Korea' is "a non-neutral term layered with hostility, threat, and disgust within the context of the National Security Law and anti-communist ideology since 1950," and added, "Calling it by its official name can convey a message of mutual respect, a willingness to reset relations, and proactive trust-building toward North Korea." (김성경 서강대 교수는 ‘북한'은 “1950년 이후 국가보안법·반공 이데올로기의 맥락 속에서 적대와 위협, 혐오가 겹겹이 쌓인 비중립적 용어”라며 “정식 국호로 호명하는 것이 북한을 향해 상호 존중 의사와 관계 재설정 의지, 선제적 신뢰 구축 메시지를 전달할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the criticism that using the name 'Joseon' conflicts with Articles 3 and 4 of the Constitution, which define the entire Korean Peninsula as the territory and aim for peaceful unification, lawyer Kwon Eun-min (PhD in North Korean Studies) offered an interpretation that "under international law, the 'use of an official name' does not automatically connect to state recognition or the establishment of diplomatic relations." Furthermore, he said, "The territorial clause (Article 3 of the Constitution) can be interpreted as a declaratory provision that indicates the scope of the territory of a unified Korea after peaceful unification is achieved." (‘조선’ 호칭이 한반도 전체를 영토로 규정하고 평화통일을 지향하는 헌법 제3·4조와 충돌한다는 지적에 대해 권은민 변호사(북한학 박사)는 “국제법상 ‘정식 국호 사용'이 국가 승인 또는 외교관계 수립과 자동 연결되지 않는다”는 해석을 내놨다. 또, “(헌법 3조) 영토조항은 평화통일이 실현된 통일한국의 영역 범위를 의미하는 선언적 규정으로 해석 가능하다”고 했다.)

Professor Lee Dong-ki of Kangwon National University noted, "In the 1960s, West Germany abandoned the West-centric designation for East Germany in the context of overcoming hostility and pursuing reconciliation and cooperation," and argued, "A shift to naming aimed at removing the toxins of mutual hostility is necessary." (이동기 강원대 교수는 “1960년대 서독이 적대의 극복과 화해협력 맥락에서 서독 중심의 동독 호칭을 포기했다”며 “상호 간 적대성 독소 제거를 위한 이름짓기로 전환할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the use of the name 'Joseon,' there is a debate between claims that it is necessary to reflect changes in mutual perceptions between the two Koreas and ease tensions, and counterarguments that it is an unconstitutional claim that acknowledges North Korea's 'two-state claim' and abandons unification. Many point out that public opinion should be carefully gathered, and a formal stance should be reached not only by the Ministry of Unification but through intense discussion and deliberation across the entire government. Vice Minister Kim stated, "The government will not rush into officially referring to North Korea by its formal name," and added, "Constitutional order, the特殊性 of inter-Korean relations, domestic legislation, international practices, and national consensus must all be comprehensively considered." (‘조선’ 호칭 사용에 대해서는 남북한의 상호 인식 변화를 반영하고 긴장 완화를 위해 필요하다는 주장과 북한의 ‘두개의 국가 주장’을 인정하고 통일을 포기하는 위헌적 주장이라는 반론이 맞선다. 신중하게 여론을 수렴하고 통일부만이 아니라 정부 전체의 치열한 논의와 숙고를 거쳐 공식 입장을 내놓아야 한다는 지적이 많다. 김 차관은 “정부가 북한의 공식 국호 표기·호명을 서두르지는 않을 것이라며 “헌법적 질서, 남북관계의 특수성, 국내 법제, 국제 관행, 국민적 공감대가 종합적으로 고려돼야 한다”고 말했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Won Oh-jung “Will drastically shorten housing redevelopment project period to within 10 years” (정원오 “주택 정비사업 기간 10년 안으로 대폭 단축할 것”)
item.description:
On the 29th, Democratic Party candidate Won Oh-jung pledged to ease regulations and improve project feasibility for housing redevelopment projects, including reconstruction and redevelopment, drastically reducing the current period of around 15 years to within 10 years. (정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 29일 재건축·재개발 등 주택 정비사업의 규제를 완화하고 사업성을 개선해 지금 15년 안팎인 주택 정비사업 기간을 10년 안으로 대폭 단축하겠다고 공약했다.)

After inspecting the Jangwi-14 housing redevelopment zone in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, on the same day, Candidate Won announced a real estate policy named "Swift Development," emphasizing speed. ( 정 후보는 이날 서울 성북구 장위14주택 재개발구역을 둘러본 뒤 속도를 강조한 ‘착착개발’이라는 이름의 부동산 정책을 발표했다. )

Candidate Won stated, "We will closely support the entire process from the start of redevelopment to moving in to accelerate development," and added, "To significantly improve the project feasibility that determines the success or failure of redevelopment projects, we will push for deregulation. We will expand areas with floor area ratio benefits to semi-industrial zones and raise the standard for calculating rental housing prices to reduce union losses." ( 정 후보는 “정비사업 시작부터 입주까지 전 과정을 밀착 지원해 개발 속도를 높이겠다”며 “정비사업 성패를 가르는 사업성을 대폭 개선하기 위해 규제 완화를 추진하겠다. 용적률 특혜 지역을 준공업지역으로 확대하고, 임대주택 가격 산정 기준을 올려 조합 손실을 줄이겠다”고 말했다. )

Candidate Won also promised to dispatch verification teams from the Seoul Housing and Communities Corporation (SH) or the Korea Real Estate Board to redevelopment areas to quickly resolve construction cost disputes. Candidate Won’s team explained, "This pledge was made in recognition that construction cost disputes are a major cause of prolonged redevelopment projects." Candidate Won also proposed transferring the authority to designate small-scale redevelopment zones under 500 households from the Seoul Metropolitan Government to local district offices. ( 정 후보는 서울주택도시개발공사(SH) 또는 한국부동산원 등의 검증단을 정비사업 지역에 파견해 공사비 분쟁을 신속히 해결하겠다고 약속했다. 정 후보 쪽은 “공사비 분쟁이 정비 사업 장기화의 주범이라는 데 주목해 만든 공약”이라고 설명했다. 정 후보는 500세대 미만 소규모 정비구역 지정 권한은 서울시에서 저치구로 이양하겠다는 공약도 내놨다. )

Additionally, Candidate Won unveiled a plan to supply 32,000 housing units early in downtown Seoul. To realize this plan, he stated he would expedite the start of construction on national and public land, military base sites, and actively pursue deregulation of aged permanent rental housing, public buildings, railway sites, and school sites. ( 정 후보는 서울 도심에 3만2천 가구를 조기에 공급하겠다는 계획도 공개했다. 계획 실현을 위해 정 후보는 국공유지·군부대 부지 등에서 공사를 조기 시작하고, 노후 영구임대주택·공공청사·철도부지·학교용지 규제 완화를 적극적으로 추진하겠다고 했다. )

Candidate Won also criticized the housing supply performance of Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party’s candidate for Seoul mayor, saying, "During the Oh Se-hoon and Yoon Seok-yol administrations, the supply of apartments and townhouses in Seoul sharply declined, with the number of permits from 2022 to 2024 being only 62% of the previous 10 years." ( 정 후보는 “오 시장과 윤석열 정부 시기 서울의 아파트·빌라 공급 물량이 급격히 줄어 2022∼2024년 인허가 건수가 직전 10년 대비 62%에 불과하다”며 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보의 주택 공급 실적을 비판하기도 했다. )

By Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr ( 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)
